replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hey ErPedra.

We don't make any exceptions to players. You were caught ban evading and using a hacked client, both of which is the worst thing to do in regarding punishment lengths. If you continue to ban evade, you will no longer be able to appeal your punishment (even after 6-8 months) so I suggest you stop. Just because you said sorry doesn't make it so your appeal is immediately accepted. You broke the rules so you must pay the time.

Regards.
Edans
